fusions.name: Storm Display
fusions.desc: Charges about in the downpour, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cupped Splash
fusions.desc: Hurls a double handful of rainwater that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunched Out the Storm
fusions.desc: Hunches over and lets the rain wash your wounds: you regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sodden Coat
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%. You also carry 10% water resistance.
